note: Deep Sleep Complex (magnesium bisglycinate, glycine, L-theanine, saffron), a nightly sachet: a direct SILT Nights rival. 22 ads, all started 18 to 25 Nov 2026, so nothing is a proven long runner yet.

patterns.title: One bold question, three benefit chips
patterns.text: Their statics are one giant question in heavy caps ("Overthinking at night?", "Sleep-deprived?"), one line naming the product, a person peeking over a duvet or dozing on the commute, and three short chips (Calm mind, Deeper sleep, Non-habit forming). Almost no other text.

patterns.title: Buying it separately costs more
patterns.text: "Still taking magnesium and glycine separately?" shows two plain bottles with prices adding up to Rs 2,000 against one tub at Rs 1,399. The enemy is the pile of single-ingredient bottles; the answer is one sachet.

patterns.title: Magnesium is not the whole answer
patterns.text: Six of 22 ads question single-ingredient magnesium ("Magnesium is everywhere right now. But is it the whole sleep solution?", "Sleep isn't a one-ingredient job") and list each active with its one job. They ride the magnesium trend instead of fighting it.

patterns.title: One product, many sleepless people
patterns.text: The same formula is pitched to the metro commuter, the night-shift worker, the gym-goer who wakes up sore and the skincare buyer. Each ad opens on that person's moment, then the same four actives.

patterns.title: Check the dose, ask for the report
patterns.text: "Ever wondered what's really in your magnesium supplement? Check the form, elemental content and demand a Certificate of Analysis." Transparency as the hook, with exact milligrams in the copy.

ideas_for_silt.format: Still life: four plain unbranded bottles (L-GLYCINE, MAGNESIUM BISGLYCINATE, ASHWAGANDHA, L-THEANINE) beside the closed Nights box and one stick
ideas_for_silt.outline: Their price-math idea in the SILT look: the pile of single bottles against one stick. Only SILT's own facts and the Rs. 900 for 15 sticks price line.

ideas_for_silt.hook: Read the lab report, not the label.
ideas_for_silt.outline: The transparency hook with SILT's own Nights lab facts (glycine 99.4% pure, L-theanine 100% pure, melatonin 0 mg), typeset cleanly. No lab name, batch or report numbers.

ideas_for_silt.format: Still life: the closed Nights box on a closed laptop
ideas_for_silt.outline: Their late-night overthinking moment without a person: the work object at rest is the hero. Main message, price and URL only.
